essential.accessibleSummary: This chart shows the proportion respondents who had not made any changes to their lifestyle to help tackle climate change, and the reasons they gave for not making a change. It shows the most common reason was that they did not think changes they made would have an impact, followed by thinking large polluters should change first. There were differences by age, parental status and whether they could afford an unexpected expense of more than £850 and this is explained in the article text
sourceText: Office for National Statistics – Opinions and Lifestyle Survey
essential.xAxisLabel: % of group who had made no changes
essential.xAxisLabel2: % of those who gave the following reason
